Package hadur2.core.gun

Class TripHammerGun

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.gun.TripHammerGun
public class TripHammerGun extends Object
GUN-8: Diamond 1.8.22's duel main gun, TripHammerKnnGun, ported. Off by default (the thgun switch); a duel only.

The view is TripHammerFormula's space and holds, per wave, the guess factor the target was found at. An aim slides the ten weights from INITIAL_WEIGHTS to FINAL_WEIGHTS, each by the view's size over its FINAL_TIMES entry (a zero there means the final weight at once), sets them on the view and asks for size / 9 neighbours up to 225. Each neighbour's firing angle is its guess factor times the orbit direction times the precise escape angle on the guess factor's side, and weighs 1 / sqrt(distance), where Diamond's distance is the weighted squared one (so the weight is one over the weighted Euclidean distance). The 59 candidate angles span the classic maximum escape angle evenly; each is scored by the cube kernel 1 - |u|^3 for |u| < 1 at a bandwidth of twice the bot width's aim angle at the wave's own distance, and the densest wins, the first on a tie. The answer is measured from the wave's absolute bearing (head-on from the wave's source), not from our next position as the other guns' are, as Diamond's is.
